Resample data with moving blocks

Source: R/block_bootstrap.R
sample_blocks.Rd

Resample data with moving blocks

Usage

sample_blocks(hawkes, num_blocks)

Arguments

hawkes

A hawkes object.

num_blocks

Number of blocks used for resampling.

Value

A hawkes object.

Examples

params <- list(
  background_rate = list(intercept = -4.5, z = 1),
  triggering_rate = 0.5,
  spatial = list(mean = 0, sd = 0.75),
  temporal = list(rate = 2),
  fixed = list(spatial = "mean")
)
data("example_background_covariates")
hawkes <- rHawkes(
  params,
  c(0, 50),
  example_background_covariates,
  covariate_columns = "z",
  spatial_burnin = 1
)

sample_blocks(hawkes, 25)
